title: Manifest SBOM Coverage
description: What the SBOM tool could not resolve when it read one commit's dependency manifests: each manifest whose declarations it could not all pin, by ecosystem. Stored as the artifact of a manifest_sbom assessment on the commit, beside its manifest SBOM (not tool_scan, whose document is code-facts). A package missing from the SBOM in an ecosystem listed here is unknown, never absent. An empty list is a complete read.

path.description: The manifest, relative to the repository root.

reason.description: no-lockfile: a manifest whose versions only a lockfile pins, with none beside it or above it in the tree. unpinned: a manifest the tool reads directly that declares requirements without an exact version (a requirements file's ranges), which it drops.
